segments.sn51.12:1.1: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā.
segments.sn51.12:1.2: Kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā?
segments.sn51.12:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti –
segments.sn51.12:1.4: ‘iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati, na ca atippaggahito bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhitto bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhitto bhavissati’.
segments.sn51.12:1.6: yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure;
segments.sn51.12:1.7: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho;
segments.sn51.12:1.8: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
segments.sn51.12:1.9: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn51.12:2.4: ‘iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati, na ca atippaggahitā bhavissati, na ca ajjhattaṃ saṃkhittā bhavissati, na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati’.
segments.sn51.12:2.6: yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure;
segments.sn51.12:2.7: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho;
segments.sn51.12:2.8: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
segments.sn51.12:2.9: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
segments.sn51.12:2.10: Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā.
segments.sn51.12:3.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti – ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti…pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti…pe….
segments.sn51.12:4.1: “Evaṃ bhāvitesu kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.

lines: Dutiyavaggassa paṭhame na ca atilīnotiādīni parato āvi bhavissanti.
Imasmiṃ sutte chaabhiññāpādakā iddhipādā kathitā, tathā dutiye ca. 3.
Yathā paṭhamasutte, tathā dutiyatatiyasuttesupi ca chaabhiññāpādakā iddhipādā kathitāti attho. 3.
